build_ResNeXt3DStemSinglePathway: build a single pathway 3D stem module with Conv3d, BatchNorm3d, ReLU, and optional MaxPool3d
build_R2Plus1DStemSinglePathway: build an R(2+1)D single pathway stem module using factorized spatial and temporal convolutions
build_ResNeXt3DStemMultiPathway: build a multi-pathway 3D stem module for SlowFast or single pathway video models
build_R2Plus1DStemMultiPathway: build a multi-pathway R(2+1)D stem module for video models with factorized convolutions
build_ResNeXt3DStem: build a simplified 3D stem wrapper that auto-configures kernel, stride, and padding from temporal and spatial sizes
